name: prune_mid_session
description: With a small context window, the zero-LLM prune replaces OLD tool results with markers before the provider call; the freshest result survives, tool_call/tool_result pairing stays intact, and the next request strictly appends to the previous one (stable prefix, KV-cache-safe).

deltas.content: Earlier steps are summarized as pruned markers; the freshest result is intact.

steps.note: run 2: request must be an append-only extension of run 1's request

deltas.content: Continuing on the same coherent history.
